description: This file defines structures, enums, and static methods related to evaluating and validating execution host requests, including security checks, command validation, and decision logic.

methods.name: validateRequest
methods.description: Validates an ExecHostRequest by checking command presence and resolving it, returning a success with validated request or a failure with error.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates an execution request in a given security context and optional approval decision, returning a policy decision (allow, deny, or require prompt).
